midshotsToday.reason: At around 8/1–9/1 his ratings and proven Group 2 sprint form offer a credible win and place route. Racing Post-associated analysis also identifies a possible front-running tactical advantage on the Rowley Mile.

lucky15Only.reason: Impressive second-start victory over 7f on turf at Leicester: disputed the pace before quickening clear. Stays at 7f for Newmarket's Group 3; Oisin Murphy on for Andrew Balding, a positive stable-rider pairing, with enough improvement potential to be interesting at 7/1–8/1.

midshotsPolicy.publicNote: 6/1–18/1 evidenced-value and each-way shortlist: recent class/form/ratings, suitable trip, positive riders and real place prospects matter more than forecast odds alone.
midshotsPolicy.priceRule: Keep an unambiguous market quote of at least 6/1 and no more than 18/1. All individual tips, in any category, must be at least 1/1.

longshotsPolicy.publicNote: One speculative 20/1+ place-value watch remains. It is not high-confidence to win, even with a plausible place profile.
longshotsPolicy.priceRule: No longshot bet if quoted under 20/1 or fewer than 8 runners after non-runners; reassess paid places.

selectionPolicy.scope: Current day's selective shortlist only. Previous paper bets and results remain in permanent ledger and archived racecard.
selectionPolicy.reviewRequired: Recheck going, non-runners, weight/draw and market within one hour of scheduled off time
selectionPolicy.confidenceNote: Do not confuse odds-on favourites with value; Prime means relative form strength only, not a calibrated winning probability.

selectionPolicy.oddsOnAction: EXCLUDE: no published tip and no new £10 paper wager if available odds are shorter than evens
